features.title: Farmer can select profile (2 toques: secano/regadío + convencional/ecológica)
features.user_visible_behavior: On first run, farmer sees two selector screens: (1) 'Mi olivar es: secano / regadío / los dos' and (2) 'Producción: convencional / ecológica'. Selection is saved locally and pre-selects on subsequent opens.
features.verification: Profile persists in SharedPreferences; app opens with pre-selected profile; profile can be changed anytime
features.notes: Critical MVP foundation — all subsequent features filter by this profile

features.title: Farmer can submit a question in the chat interface
features.user_visible_behavior: After selecting profile, farmer sees chat screen with large input field and keyboard. Can type or use suggested questions. Taps send to transmit to server.
features.verification: Chat screen compiles; input transmits without error; suggested questions render as tappable buttons
features.notes: Depends on F1 profile being displayed first

features.title: System returns answer with citations from official documents
features.user_visible_behavior: After submitting question, farmer sees burbujas with 'pensando…' state. Response includes text with citations [1], [2], ..., tarjeta de fuente (norma, artículo, enlace, fecha), fecha de verificación, and aviso legal.
features.verification: End-to-end: question submitted → answer displayed with ≥1 citation; fuentes existentes en contexto; formato JSON {found, answer, sources}; aviso legal visible; fecha verificación en dd/mm/aaaa
features.notes: Core RAG pipeline — depends on backend embedding/search being configured

features.title: Profile of 2 toques persists locally between app sessions
features.user_visible_behavior: After selecting profile, closing and reopening the app the same profile is displayed pre-selected. No user account required — data stored in device SharedPreferences.
features.verification: Profile value read from SharedPreferences on app restart matches last selection; changes persist across sessions
features.notes: Depends on F1 — local persistence mechanism for the profile

features.title: App says 'no lo fijo' when answer not found in corpus (below threshold)
features.user_visible_behavior: When hybrid search similarity is below minimum threshold, response shows fixed message: 'No he encontrado esta información en los documentos oficiales que tengo. Te recomiendo consultar con tu oficina comarcal agraria o con tu cooperativa.' without calling the LLM.
features.verification: Question submitted where answer not in corpus → fixed 'no lo fijo' message appears; LLM not called (latency saved); mensaje fijo sin texto libre; incluye remisión a oficina/comarcal
features.notes: Critical for reliability — avoids invented answers; depends on F3 having LLM response path

features.title: Legal notice and verification date displayed with answers
features.user_visible_behavior: Every answer includes: (1) 'Información orientativa basada en documentos oficiales. No sustituye el asesoramiento profesional.' fixed text, (2) 'Tu cooperativa puede tener plazos internos anteriores a los oficiales. Confírmalo con ella.' when plazos present, (3) 'Documentos verificados por última vez dd/mm/aaaa.' with actual date.
features.verification: Answer displayed with all three legal notice components; dates in dd/mm/aaaa format; no libres texto en avisos; PII filter active before LLM
features.notes: Mandatory by policy — separates orientativo from asesoramiento profesional

features.title: Farmer can submit feedback (👍/👎 with motive) after answer
features.user_visible_behavior: After receiving answer, farmer sees 👍/👎 buttons with optional text field '¿Por qué?' . Selection is recorded and sent to backend. No personal data collected.
features.verification: 👍 and 👎 buttons render; optional motive field accepts text; feedback transmits to /feedback endpoint without PII; logged in backend with pregunta hash
features.notes: Feeds 'no lo fijo' task queue and golden dataset; depends on F3 answer being displayed

features.title: Coverage screen shows what topics are covered and what are not
features.user_visible_behavior: From main screen or profile selector, farmer taps 'Cobertura' badge. Screen shows green checkmarks for covered topics (PAC, plazos, ayudasdirectas) and 'beta' label for ecological segment. Explainslimits.
features.verification: Coverage screen compiles; topics with docs show checkmark; ecological segment labeled 'beta'; no topics without docs shown as checkmark; text explains 'what we don't cover yet'
features.notes: Depends on F1 — needs profile to determine which coverage map to show

features.title: Ecológico segment labeled 'beta' on coverage screen
features.user_visible_behavior: On coverage screen, ecological segment items have 'beta' badge/text. Tapping explains 'ainfo still being validated with ecological users.' Other segments (convencional) have no badge.
features.verification: Coverage screen renders; ecological items have 'beta' visual treatment; convencional items have no badge; tapping ecological items shows validation message
features.notes: Depends on F8 — UI refinement on top of coverage screen

features.title: Critical mode shows literal fragment + source + date for critico:true topics
features.user_visible_behavior: When answer involves plazos, importes, umbrales, or requisitos (critico:true in metadata), response includes: literal fragment from document, fuente citation with URL and date, and explicit statement 'modo extractivo: fragmento literal'. Fixed closing line added by code.
features.verification: Question about plazo/importe/umbral → response includes [fragmento literal] with [fuente] and [fecha]; 'modo extractivo' label visible; 'No inventamos datos' principle observed; PII not in fragment
features.notes: Depends on F3 — requires chunk metadata critico flag and extractivo code path
